title.en: On this day the world was completed

fragments.text: הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם. הַיּוֹם יַעֲמִיד בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. כָּל יְצוּרֵי עוֹלָמִים. אִם כְּבָנִים. אִם כַּעֲבָדִים. אִם כְּבָנִים רַחֲמֵנוּ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. וְאִם כַּעֲבָדִים עֵינֵינוּ לְךָ תְּלוּיוֹת. עַד שֶׁתְּחָנֵּנוּ וְתוֹצִיא כָאוֹר מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ אָיוֹם קָדוֹשׁ:

On this day the world was completed. On this day He brings to judgment all the world’s creatures, either like children or like slaves. If like children, then have mercy upon us as a father has mercy on children. If like slaves, then our eyes are lifted to Thee until Thou wilt be gracious to us and make our verdict shine forth like light, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One.

title.en: On this day the world was completed
May the utterance of our lips be pleasing

fragments.text: אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא. מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל
(זִכְרוֹן)
תְּרוּעָתֵנוּ וּתְקַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן סֵדֶר מַלְכֻיּוֹתֵנוּ:
May the utterance of our lips be pleasing before Thee, O lofty and exalted God, who understands and listens, pays heed and hearkens to the sound of
(the memory of)
our Teruah. Mayest Thou accept with compassion and favour the order of our praises of Thy Kingdom.

אַתָּה זוֹכֵר מַעֲשֵׂה עוֹלָם וּפוֹקֵד כָּל־יְצֽוּרֵי קֶֽדֶם. לְפָנֶֽיךָ נִגְלוּ כָּל־תַּעֲלֻמוֹת וַהֲמוֹן נִסְתָּרוֹת שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. כִּי אֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ: אַתָּה זוֹכֵר אֶת־כָּל־הַמִּפְעָל. וְגַם כָּל־הַיְצוּר לֹא נִכְחָד מִמֶּֽךָּ. הַכֹּל גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט עַד סוֹף כָּל־הַדּוֹרוֹת. כִּי תָבִיא חֹק זִכָּרוֹן לְהִפָּקֵד כָּל־רֽוּחַ וָנָֽפֶשׁ. לְהִזָּכֵר מַעֲשִׂים רַבִּים וַהֲמוֹן בְּרִיּוֹת לְאֵין תַּכְלִית. מֵרֵאשִׁית כָּזֹאת הוֹדָֽעְתָּ. וּמִלְּפָנִים אוֹתָהּ גִּלִּֽיתָ. זֶה הַיּוֹם תְּחִלַּת מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ זִכָּרוֹן לְיוֹם רִאשׁוֹן. כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב: וְעַל הַמְּדִינוֹת בּוֹ יֵאָמַר אֵיזוֹ לַחֶֽרֶב. וְאֵיזוֹ לַשָּׁלוֹם. אֵיזוֹ לָרָעָב. וְאֵיזוֹ לַשֹּֽׂבַע. וּבְרִיּוֹת בּוֹ יִפָּקֵֽדוּ. לְהַזְכִּירָם לַחַיִּים וְלַמָּֽוֶת: מִי לֹא נִפְקָד כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל הַיְצוּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא. מַעֲשֵׂה אִישׁ וּפְקֻדָּתוֹ. וַעֲלִילוֹת מִצְעֲדֵי גָֽבֶר. מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם וְתַחְבּוּלוֹתָיו וְיִצְרֵי מַעַלְלֵי אִישׁ: אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁלֹּא יִשְׁכָּחֶֽךָּ. וּבֶן־אָדָם יִתְאַמֶּץ־בָּךְ. כִּי דוֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ לְעוֹלָם לֹא יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ. וְלֹא יִכָּלְמוּ לָנֶֽצַח כָּל־הַחוֹסִים בָּךְ: כִּי זֵֽכֶר כָּל־הַמַּעֲשִׂים לְפָנֶֽיךָ בָּא. וְאַתָּה דוֹרֵשׁ מַעֲשֵׂה כֻלָּם:

וְגַם אֶת־נֹחַ בְּאַהֲבָה זָכַֽרְתָּ. וַתִּפְקְדֵֽהוּ בִּדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים בַּהֲבִיאֲךָ אֶת־מֵי הַמַּבּוּל לְשַׁחֵת כָּל־בָּשָׂר מִפְּנֵי רֽוֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם. עַל־כֵּן זִכְרוֹנוֹ בָּא לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ לְהַרְבּוֹת זַרְעוֹ כְּעַפְרוֹת תֵּבֵל. וְצֶֽאֱצָאָיו כְּחוֹל הַיָּם:

Thou rememberest the work of the world and Thou art aware of all creatures of antiquity. Before Thee all secrets are revealed and the multitude of hidden things from the beginning of time. There is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and there is nought concealed before Thine eyes. Thou rememberest every deed and not even one creature is hidden from Thee. Everything is exposed and known before Thee, O Lord our God, watching and looking to the end of all generations. For Thou dost bring a fixed time for remembrance, when every spirit and soul will be considered and many deeds and an infinite mass of creatures will be remembered. From the beginning hast Thou made this known and long ago revealed it. This is the day of the beginning of Thy works, a memorial of the first day, for it is a statute for Israel, a judgment for the God of Jacob. And regarding territories, it is decided on it which shall be for the sword and which for peace, which for famine and which for plenty. And the creatures will be considered on it to be mentioned either for life or death. Who is not considered on this day? Indeed the memory of every created thing comes before Thee, man’s work and his task, the actions of man’s footsteps, man’s thought and his devices, and the motives of man’s deeds. Fortunate the man who does not forget Thee and the son of man who clings to Thee, for those that seek Thee will never stumble nor will those that take refuge with Thee ever be disgraced. For the remembrance of all actions comes before Thee and Thou dost examine all of them.

Noah also didst Thou remember in love and consider for the sake of salvation and compassion when Thou didst bring the waters of the flood to destroy all flesh because of the wickedness of their actions. Therefore his memory came before Thee, O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea.

Therefore his memory came before Thee O Lord our God, to increase his descendants like the dust of the earth and his offspring like the sand of the sea,

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ זָכְרֵנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶיךָ וּפָקְדֵנוּ בִּפְקֻדַּת יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים מִשְּׁמֵי שְׁמֵי קֶדֶם וּזְכָר־לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַבְּרִית וְאֶת־הַחֶסֶד וְאֶת־הַשְּׁבוּעָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶיךָ עֲקֵדָה שֶׁעָקַד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ אֶת־יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ עַל גַּב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ וְכָבַשׁ רַחֲמָיו לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנְךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם כֵּן יִכְבְּשׁוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ אֶת־כַּעַסְךָ מֵעָלֵינוּ וּבְטוּבְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יָשׁוּב חֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ מֵעַמְּךָ וּמֵעִירְךָ וּמִנַּחֲלָתֶךָ. וְקַיֶּם־לָנוּ יְיָ
אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶךָ כָּאָמוּר:

Our God and God of our fathers, remember us with a good remembrance before Thee and consider us with salvation and compassion from the ancient heavens and remember on our behalf, O Lord our God, the covenant and the grace and the oath which Thou hast sworn to our father Abraham on Mount Moriah and let there appear before Thee the scene when Abraham our father bound his son Isaac on the altar and subdued his compassion in order to do Thy will with a whole heart. Thus let Thy compassion subdue Thy wrath from upon us and in Thy great goodness let the fury of Thine anger turn back from Thy people, Thy city and Thine inheritance. Fulfil for us, O Lord our God, the word that Thou
hast promised us in Thy Torah, through Thy servant Moses through the mouth of Thy glory, as it is said:
וְזָכַרְתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית רִאשֹׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתִי־אֹתָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם לִהְיוֹת לָהֶם לֵאלֹהִים אֲנִי יְיָ:
‘And I shall remember on their behalf the covenant with their predecessors whom I brought out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations in order to become their God, I am the Lord’.
זְכֹר בְּרִית אַבְרָהָם וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק וְהָשֵׁב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:
Remember the covenant of Abraham and the binding of Isaac and return the captivity of the tents of Jacob and save us for the sake of Thy Name.

fragments.text: כִּי זוֹכֵר כָּל־הַנִּשְׁכָּחוֹת אַתָּה הוּא מֵעוֹלָם וְאֵין שִׁכְחָה לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ. וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק לְזַרְעוֹ
(שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב)
הַיּוֹם בְּרַחֲמִים תִּזְכּוֹר. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ זוֹכֵר הַבְּרִית:

For Thou dost remember from eternity all that has been forgotten and there is no forgetfulness before Thy glorious throne and the binding of Isaac wilt Thou remember on behalf of his seed in compassion this day. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who remembers the covenant.
תקיעה: שברים: תקיעה:
אַתָּה נִגְלֵיתָ בַּעֲנַן כְּבוֹדֶךָ עַל עַם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְדַבֵּר עִמָּם מִן הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּם קוֹלֶךָ וְנִגְלֵיתָ עֲלֵיהֶם בְּעַרְפַלֵּי טֹהַר. גַּם

הָעוֹלָם כֻּלּוֹ חָל מִפָּנֶיךָ וּבְרִיּוֹת בְּרֵאשִׁית חָרְדוּ מִמֶּךָּ בְּהִגָּלוֹתְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ עַל־הַר סִינַי לְלַמֵּד לְעַמְּךָ תּוֹרָה וּמִצְווֹת. וַתַּשְׁמִיעֵם אֶת־הוֹד קוֹלֶךָ וְדִבְּרוֹת קָדְשְׁךָ מִלַּהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ, בְּקֹלוֹת וּבְרָקִים עֲלֵיהֶם נִגְלֵיתָ וּבְקוֹל שֹׁפָר עֲלֵיהֶם הוֹפָעְתָּ:

Thou hast revealed Thyself in the cloud of Thy glory to Thy holy people in order to speak with them, from heaven hast Thou made Thy voice heard to them and in clouds of purity hast Thou revealed Thyself to them. The whole world trembled before Thee and the creatures of the creation were in awe of Thee when Thou didst reveal Thyself, O our King, on Mount Sinai in order to teach Thy people Torah and commandment. Thou didst make them hear the majesty of Thy voice and Thy holy words out of fiery flames. With thunder and lightning didst Thou reveal Thyself to them and with the sound of the Shofar didst Thou appear to them.

title.en: On this day the world was completed

fragments.text: הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם. הַיּוֹם יַעֲמִיד בַּמִּשְׁפָּט. כָּל יְצוּרֵי עוֹלָמִים. אִם כְּבָנִים. אִם כַּעֲבָדִים. אִם כְּבָנִים רַחֲמֵנוּ כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל בָּנִים. וְאִם כַּעֲבָדִים עֵינֵינוּ לְךָ תְּלוּיוֹת. עַד שֶׁתְּחָנֵּנוּ וְתוֹצִיא כָאוֹר מִשְׁפָּטֵנוּ אָיוֹם קָדוֹשׁ:

On this day the world was completed. On this day He brings to judgment all the world’s creatures, either like children or like slaves. If like children, then have mercy upon us as a father has mercy on children. If like slaves, then our eyes are lifted to Thee until Thou wilt be gracious to us and make our verdict shine forth like light, O Awe-inspiring and Holy One.

title.en: May the utterance of our lips be pleasing

fragments.text: אֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתֵינוּ יֶעֱרַב לְפָנֶיךָ אֵל רָם וְנִשָּׂא. מֵבִין וּמַאֲזִין מַבִּיט וּמַקְשִׁיב לְקוֹל

our Teruah. Mayest Thou accept with compassion and favour the order of our praises of Thy Kingdom.

fragments.text: זֵֽכֶר תְּחִלַּת כָּל מַעַשׂ. אֲשֶׁר בְּכָל שָׁנָה נַעַשׂ. תּוֹחַלְתָּם לִמְאַס. יוֹצֵר בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
תּוֹכַחַת מַעַשׂ. אִם יָצְאָה בְּכַעַס. תּוֹמֵךְ לְמַעֲנוֹ יַעַשׂ. וִיצוּרִים יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵֽכֶר שֶׁמִּבְּרֵאשִׁית. תְּבוּאַת רֵאשִׁית. שֹֽׁרֶשׁ בִּכּוּר רֵאשִׁית. יֵרָא וְיִזְכּוֹר:
שֶֽׁצֶף חֲרִישִׁית. אִם חָר לְהָשִׁית. שׁוּבָה אֲשֶׁר הֵשִׁית. לַשּׁוֹבָבִים יִזְכֹּר:
זֵֽכֶר רֹאשׁ עֲפָרוֹת. וְתוֹלָדוֹת סְפוּרוֹת. רְשׁוּם סְפוּרוֹת. לְמִסְפַּר חוֹל יִזְכּוֹר:
רֹבַע מִסְפָּרוֹת. מְחַנְנֵי לְכַפָּרֹת. רֶֽגֶשׁ שׁוֹפָרֹת. לְשַׁפְּרֵם יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵֽכֶר קְרִיאַת סֵֽפֶר. אֲשֶׁר גָּלְמִי שִׁפֵּר. קָצַב לוֹ בַּסֵּֽפֶר. בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר לִזְכּוֹר:
קֶֽצֶב אִם
הֶחֱרַט בַּסֵּֽפֶר. לְבִלְתִּי מְצוֹא כֹּֽפֶר. קִיּוּם זִכְרוֹן זֶה סֵֽפֶר. לְפָנָיו יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵֽכֶר צָפוּן מֹרְדֵי אוֹר. תָּמִים דּוֹר כָּאוֹר. צִיָּה כְּחָר לָאוֹר. קְנוּיָו יִזְכֹּר:
צְפוּפִים פְּנֵי נָאוֹר. מִשְׁפָּטָם תֵּת לָאוֹר. צַחַן רוֹעַ שְׂאוֹר. בְּרִיב בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵֽכֶר פְּעֻלַּת אֶזְרָח. הֵעַרְתָּהּ מִמִּזְרָח. פָּעֳלוֹ יִזְרָח. בְּקֶֽרֶב שָׁנִים יִזְכֹּר:
פַּח אִם הָטְרַח. פִּרְחָיו לְמָרַח. פִּלּוּלוֹ יִצְרַח. בַּעֲדָם יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵֽכֶר עֲקֵדַת מוֹרִיָּה. כְּהִיַּת רְאִיָּה. עֲדֵי עֵרוֹם וְעֶרְיָה. סְבוּכוֹ יִזְכּוֹר:
עֵֽצֶב טְרִיָּה. אִם כּוֹאֲבָה פּוֹרִיָּה. עֲתָרוֹ לִרְאִיָּה. וְלִזְכוּת יִזְכֹּר:
זֵֽכֶר סֻלָּם חָלָם. וְעָלָיו מְחוֹלְלָם. שָׂרֵי אַרְבַּע וְעֻלָּם. בּוֹ כְּמֵאָז יִזְכֹּר:
שְׂרִיגָיו בְּמַעֲלָם. וְיֹאמַר לְגָעֳלָם. שִׂיחוֹ
יוֹעִילָם. בְּרִית לִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר נְקוּבֵי מַטּוֹת. שְׁבוּעוֹת מַטּוֹת. נְדִידוֹת הַמַּטּוֹת. לְאַמְּצָם יִזְכֹּר:
נֹשְׂאֵי עֹל מוֹטַת. אִם פָּץ לְהַמְטוֹת. נֶפֶץ חֲדַר הַמִּטּוֹת. לְכִפּוּר יִזְכֹּר:
זֵכֶר מְצוּקִים. יְסוֹד מוּצָקִים. מִפְעָלָם לְצַעֲקִים. בְּפוּט חָשׁ לִזְכּוֹר:
מִפִּי יוֹנְקִים. אֲשֶׁר בַּסּוּף נֶאֱקִים. מַאֲמַר בְּרִית וְחֻקִּים. דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ יִזְכֹּר:
זֵכֶר לִין כְּפָרִים. וְאִמְרֵי שְׁפָרִים. לִמְשַׁלְּמֵי פָרִים. בְּשָׂפָה יִזְכֹּר:
לְעֵת בִּקּוּר סְפָרִים. סְתָרִים מְסַפְּרִים. לִשְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. לְצֶדֶק יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר כְּבוֹד מִשְׁכָּן. מְקוֹם דּוֹד שִׁכַּן. כְּרוּבִים בּוֹ שִׁכַּן. חֶסֶד נְעוּרִים יִזְכֹּר:
כִּיּוֹר עִם כַּן. וְנֹעַם קוֹל דּוּכַן. כַּבִּיר בְּיוֹם מוּכַן. לַנְּבוֹנִים יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר יְלִיד נוּן. וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי אוּרִי אֶפְנוּן. יִזָּכְרוּ בְּרִנּוּן. פִּלְאָם לִזְכּוֹר:
יֶקֶשׁ בְּרַק הַשָּׁנוּן. אִם הָשְׁלַף לְתַאֲנוּן. יַקְשִׁיב תַּחֲנוּן. חֲנוּנָיו לִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר טַעַם שֹׁפְטִים. וְאוֹת קְצִיר חִטִּים. טֶפֶשׁ שׁוֹטִים. יְחַתֵּל מִלִּזְכּוֹר:
טֹרַח אַרְבַּעַת שְׁפָטִים. אִם נֶעֶנְשׁוּ נִשְׁפָּטִים. טֶבַע מִשְׁפָּטִים. אֲשֶׁר שָׂם יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר חֲצוֹת לַיְלָה. וְתוֹדוֹת מִשְׁפְּטֵי לָיְלָה. חֹשֶׁךְ בְּאִישׁוֹן לַיְלָה. נִגּוּנוֹ לָמוֹ יִזְכּוֹר:
חֵקֶר מִפְקַד לַיְלָה. יַגִּיהַּ בְּלַהַב לָיְלָה. חֹק הֶגֶה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה. לְגִיהָם יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר זֶה זְבוּל. אֲשֶׁר בְּבִצְעִי חָבוּל. זְדוֹנוֹת סָבוּל. עוֹד בַּל יִזְכּוֹר:
זַעַם כַּמַּבּוּל. אִם יָצְאָה לְחִבּוּל. זִכְרֹן יֶרַח בּוּל. לְחֶמְלָה יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר וְכַח
כָּל פֹּעַל. בְּקַו וָפֶלֶס יַעַל. וְאִם בְּמֶרֶד וְאִם בְּמַעַל. רַב חֶסֶד יִזְכֹּר:
וְאִם טוֹב וְאִם רַע. אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ יֵאָרַע. וֶסְתּוֹ יִפָּרַע. בְּסַאסְּאָה מִלִּזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר הַחַיִּים. עַד כַּמֶּה הֵם חַיִּים. הֵן לַמָּוֶת אִם לַחַיִּים. חַי חַי יִזְכּוֹר:
הֲמוֹן שְׁאוֹן בְּרוּאִים. יַעַבְרוּ לְפָנָיו כִּמְרִיאִים. הֲלֹא כְּמוֹ רְאוּיִים. לְכָל אֶחָד יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר דַּלּוּת וָעֹשֶׁר. בַּצֹּרֶת וָחֹשֶׁר. דּוֹפִי וְגַם יֹשֶׁר. בַּדִּין הוּא יִזְכּוֹר:
דְּבַר גָּלוּי וָסֵתֶר. בִּנְיָנוֹת וְסוֹתֵר. דֵּי חָסֵר וָיֶתֶר. לְקֶצֶב יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר גְּנוּנִים לְיַשֵּׁב. בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיוֹשֵׁב. גֶּשֶׁם וְרוּחַ לְנַשֵּׁב. מֵהַיּוֹם יִזְכּוֹר:
גָּרוֹן לְהַקְשֵׁב. מֵעַם שְׁמוֹ חוֹשֵׁב. גָּלְיוֹת לְהָשֵׁב. בְּיוֹם תֶּקַע יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר בַּהַל וְחֵמָה. קְרָב
וּמִלְחָמָה. בִּקּוּעַ חוֹמָה. לְחוֹמַת יָם יִזְכֹּר:
בָּאָדָם וּבַבְּהֵמָה. אִם הָקְנַס מְהוּמָה. בְּצוּר קוֹל הוֹמָה. לָאֲדָמָה יִזְכּוֹר:
זֵכֶר אֱמוּנָה וָשֶׁקֶר. אוֹזֶן שִׂיחַ וָסֶקֶר. אוֹת פְּקֻדַּת בֹּקֶר. לִרְגָעִים יִזְכּוֹר:
אִם לְזוֹל אִם לִיקֶר. אוֹ לָטַעַת אוֹ לְעַקֶּר. אֱנוֹשׁ בְּדִקְדּוּק וָחֵקֶר. לַמִּשְׁפָּט יִזְכֹּר:
On the day of memory of the beginning of all action, let the Creator not remember those of the deeds of the whole year that are in conflict with Israel’s hopes.
If reproof for those deeds has gone forth in anger, may He grant help for His own sake and remember the creatures.
May He look and recall the memory of the people He first appointed, the first harvest, the root of the first fruit.
When in His anger He determines to send severe punishment, may He remember the atonement which He has ordained for the faithless.
He remembers the first man who was formed from dust, the countless generations and the inscribed (good deeds) on behalf of the people that is like the sand in number.
He remembers those counted in four camps who implore expiation and sound the Shofar in order to purify themselves.
He remembers what was read out from the book that was bestowed by Him upon the first man even before its completion. He had decided in that book that He was to be remembered in every generation.
When anger is written down in the book and no
atonement can be found, then He remembers the confirmation of this book.
He remembers the hidden one (Noah) in the age of open rebels, the perfect and the pure; when He is angry and wishes to curse the earth, He remembers those acquired by Him (Israel).
As to those who stand crowded together before the countenance of the Awe-inspiring, may He bring to light their judgment; may He not in strife recall the ugly evil leaven.
He remembers the work of that strong one whom He told to rise up from the east (Abraham). May He soon recall his shining act.
When destruction threatens to annihilate his offspring, may his supplication become audible that He may remember them kindly.
He remembers the sacrifice on Moriah (Isaac) whose eyes become dim; for the sake of people naked and bare, may He recall the ram caught in the thicket.
When the fruitful people is afflicted with a festering wound, may his prayer be manifest that God may remember his merit.
He remembers him who saw the ladder in the dream (Jacob); above it the Creator appeared to him, showed him the princes of the four empires and their yoke. He will remember him, as in former days.
When His
adherents are faithless and the Lord intends to reject them, may his prayer avail them that on their behalf the covenant may be remembered.
He remembers the noble tribes (twelve), the oath of the tribes, the wanderings of the tribes does He recall, to strengthen them.
When He says that He will crush those who bear the heavy yoke, then He remembers as an atonement the destruction of the site of the Sanctuary.
He remembers the foundation stones (forefathers), who groan in Egyptian slavery.
The sucklings who praised the Lord at the Sea of Reeds, the promise of the covenant (the circumcision) and the statutes (of the Torah), His holy word, all these does He remember.
The memory of those who live austerely (students of the Torah) and study His beautiful sayings, who with their lips provide a substitute for sacrificial bullocks, He does remember.
When the books that announce what is hidden, are examined, He remembers in love the wonderful pair of brothers.
He remembers the honour of the sanctuary, the place where He, the Beloved, did dwell, where He allowed the Cherubim to rest, the love of our youth He remembers.
The basin on its frame, the delightful voice (of the Levites) on the Temple steps, the Almighty recalls them in favour of the discerning on the appointed day of judgment.
He remembers (Joshua) the son of Nun, and the illuminating words of him who comes from Yephuneh, (Caleb), may they be recalled in prayer so that their deeds should be remembered.
When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for grief, may He hear and remember the supplications of those He has favoured.
He remembers the noble judges and the sign given by Samuel at the time of the wheat harvest. He heals the folly of the simple, so that it is no longer remembered.
When the destructive gleaming sword is drawn for the four punishments, may He remember the nature of the judgments He gave them.
May He remember the hymns of praise in which David, at midnight, praised the rules of the night, may He remember his song in the darkness of the night on their behalf.
May He illuminate the nightly search by the fire of the night upon the altar; the law in which they study by day and by night, may He remember for their healing.
He remembers the palace that was taken from me on account of my selfishness. May He no longer recall that it was laden with deliberate sins.
When anger, as at the time of the flood, is aroused in destruction, let Him remember the month of Bul (the completion of the Temple) in compassion.
He re
members the test of every creature according to measure and in the scales; when they have committed acts of rebellion and faithlessness, may He remember them, full of compassion.
As to the good and the evil whose deeds and way of life should be requited, may He not remember them according to the severity of the law.
He remembers life, how long their life shall be; for death or for life He remembers all the living.
The noisy throng of creatures passes before Him like lambs; He remembers each according to his worth.
He remembers poverty and wealth, need and plenty, vice and virtue; in judgment does He remember.
The open and the hidden, building and tearing down, death and superfluity, does He measure and remember.
He remembers those who should live sheltered in the wilderness or in settlements; to send rain and wind does He remember.
To hear the prayer of the people that reveres His Name and to lead back the exiles does He remember on the day of the Tekiah.
He recalls terror and wrath, battle and wars; the destruction of
the wall (Jerusalem) He remembers against the wall of the sea.
When confusion has been decreed as punishment for man and beast, He remembers the loud entreaty of the earth.
He remembers fidelity and falsehood by ear, speech and glance, the test of every morning and every moment does He recall.
He remembers abundance or scarcity, planting or uprooting, for mankind with care and searching in judgment.

fragments.text: אֶפְחַד בְּמַעֲשַׂי. אֶדְאַג בְּכָל עֵת. אִירָא בְּיוֹם דִּין. בְּבוֹאִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
אֶדְרוֹשׁ לְחַנּוּן. אֲחַלֶּה לְרַחוּם. אֲחַנֵּן לְחַק לִי. יוֹם לְזִכָּרוֹן:
בְּבוֹאִי לְמִשְׁפָּט. בְּמִי אֶשָּׁעֵן. וּמִי יְחַפֶּשׂ לִי. צֶֽדֶק לְזִכָּרוֹן:
בָּאָבוֹת בָּטַֽחְתִּי. וּפָעֳלָם אָכַֽלְתִּי. וְהֵם הָיוּ לִי. קֶֽדֶם לְזִכָּרוֹן:
גָּבְרָה זְרוֹעִי. כְּשָׂח מְחֵנִי נָא. לְבַל יִמַּח מֶנִּי. שֵׁם וְזִכָּרוֹן:
גֶּֽבֶר אִם יַעֲמוֹד לְפָנָיו הֲיוֹעִיל. בְּעֵת יְבֻקַּשׁ מֶנִּי. זְכוּת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
דַּצְתִּי בְּלוֹבֵשׁ אֵפוֹד. וְחֹֽשֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּט. אֲשֶׁר בָּם הוּחַק. שְׁמִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
דִּלֵּג בְּמַחְתָּה. עַד יֵעָצֵר נֶֽגֶף. בְּגֶֽשֶׁת זָר מְכַהֵן. יָקוּד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
הַבִּֽיטָה אֵל. בְּעָמְדִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ. אֵין בְּקִרְבִּי אֱנוֹשׁ. תָּוִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
הֲיֵשׁ מִי יְפַלֵּל. וְיָשִׁיב
חֵמָה. וְיוּחַק לַדּוֹרֹת. שְׁמוֹ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
וּמִי שׂוֹנֵא בֶֽצַע. יְדַבֵּר עֲנוּ בִי. וַיַּעַן וְיֹאמַר עֵד. אָדוֹן לְזִכָּרוֹן:
וּבְטָלֵה חָלָב. יְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדֵנוּ. וּכְנֶֽגֶד שְׁנֵי עֳפָרִים. יַעַל לְזִכָּרוֹן:
זַֽעַף יֵרָא וְיֹאמַר. תְּהִי יָדְךָ בִי. אֲשֶׁר כְּלֵב אֱלֹהָיו. הוּא לְזִכָּרוֹן:
זָעַק וְהֵשִׁיב. חֶֽרֶב אֶל נְדָנָהּ. וְהוּשַׁת לוֹ כַּשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ. כֵּס לְזִכָּרוֹן:
חִכֵּתִי בְּעֵת עֶצֶר. לְפוֹתֵחַ וּמַמְטִיר. כְּמֵשִׁיב רוּחַ לַיֶּֽלֶד. אָבוּד מִזִּכָּרוֹן:
חַי לִרְאוֹת בְּרִית. בְּדַבְּרוֹ קִנֵּאתִי. כִּי עָזְבוּ עָם. בְּרִית וְזִכָּרוֹן:
טֶֽרֶם הָיָה לִי. מְכַפֵּר פָּנִים. מִנְחָה הֹלֶֽכֶת. כַּשֹּׁחַד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
טֶֽרֶף נֵרְדְּ וְסַמִּים. לְמֵסַב חֲדָרָיו. דַּם וָחֵֽלֶב לְנִיחֹחַ. וְלֶֽחֶם הַפָּנִים לְזִכָּרוֹן:
יֻצַּֽגְתִּי עַל גֶּחָלֵי רֵיקָה. כִּי לֹא אַלְמָן. שַׁתִּי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
יָהּ אֶבְטַח בָּךְ. וְלֹא
בִּנְדִיבִים. כִּי הֵם בַּקֶּבֶר. וְלָנֶצַח שִׁמְךָ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כָּל אֵלֶּה סְמָכוּנִי. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ בִּקַּשְׁתִּי. לוּלֵא הֵם תַּמֹּתִי. וְאֵינִי לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כִּי הֵם בִּזְרוֹעַ. עָדֶיךָ לֹא בָאוּ. רוֹמְמוּתֶיךָ בְּפִיהֶם. שָׂמוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
לְיוֹם זֶה נִכְמָס. סֶכֶם חֶשְׁבּוֹנוֹת. תְּחִלָּה לְיָמִים. וְרֹאשׁ לְזִכָּרֹן:
לְהִקָּרֵא בוֹ. כְּתַב עֵט וְשָׁמִיר. גָּלוּי וּבָאֵר. וְיָדוּעַ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
מָוֶת וְחַיִּים. שָׁלוֹם וּמִלְחָמוֹת. צַחֲצָחוֹת וָשׂוֹבַע. בָּאִים לְזִכָּרוֹן:
מַעַלְלֵי גֶבֶר. וּמִסְפַּר צְעָדָיו. נִשְׁכְּחוּ מֵאֱנוֹשׁ. וְלָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן:
נִסְתְּרָה דַרְכִּי. מִי יוּכַל שִׂיחַ. לַשָּׁוְא נִכְתַּב לִי. חֵטְא לְזִכָּרוֹן:
נֶגֶד פְּנֵי גֶבֶר. מַעֲשָׂיו יוֹכִיחוּ. וְיַעֲנֶה בּוֹ כַּחֲשׁוֹ. עֵד לְזִכָּרוֹן:
שִׂיחוּ מְזִמּוֹת אֵל. יַחַד כָּל בְּנֵי אִישׁ. עוֹבְרֵי תַּחַת שֵׁבֶט. כַּצֹּאן לְזִכָּרוֹן:
סוֹגֵר
דֶּלֶת. בְּעַד תְּמִימִים בְּזַעַם. עַד בֹּא קִצָּם. צֵאת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם:
עֲשֵׂה פֶלֶא לְחַיִּים. לְבַל יִהְיוּ כַּמֵּתִים. הֲיֵשׁ אֲמִתֶּךָ. בַּקֶּבֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן:
עוֹרַרְתָּ אָז בְּפֹעַל. עוֹרְרֵנוּ בְּלֹא פֹעַל. הֲלֹא לְנִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ. תַּעַשׂ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ
זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר
טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
פְּנֵה אֱלֹהִים. בְּיוֹשְׁבֵי גַנִּים. מַקְשִׁיב לְנִדְבָּרֵימוֹ. בְּדַת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
פָּעֳלָם לְפָנֶיךָ. וּשְׂכָרָם אִתָּךְ. אוֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים. בַּסֵּפֶר לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶךָ
אָז נִדְבְּרוּ יִרְאֵי יְיָ אִישׁ אֶל רֵעֵהוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁב יְיָ וַיִּשְׁמָע וַיִּכָּתֵב סֵפֶר זִכָּרוֹן לְפָנָיו לְיִרְאֵי יְיָ וּלְחוֹשְׁבֵי שְׁמוֹ:
צָצוּ שֻׁעָלִים. מְחַבְּלִים כְּרָמִים. לְהַכְרִית מִגֶּפֶן. שֹׁרֶשׁ וְזִכָּרוֹן:
צְרָרוּם בְּפֶרֶךְ. נָאֲקוּ וְנוֹשָׁעוּ. בְּכֹשֶׁר הֲרָרֵי קֶדֶם. הוּחַק לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יִצְחָק וְאֶת־יַעֲקֹב:
קֶדֶם בַּנְתָּה לַדּוֹרוֹת. אֵין בָּהֶם חֵפֶץ. חִלַּפְתָּם וְאִבַּדְתָּם. מִהְיוֹת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
קֲחְתָּה דּוֹר מֵאֶלֶף. אֲמָרֶיךָ הִנְחַלְתָּם. לְמַעֲנָם בְּכָל דּוֹר. חַקְתָּה לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ
זָכַר לְעֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר:
רָם חָשַׁק מְאֹד. בְּכַלַּת נְעוּרִים. הֲרוּגֶיהָ וַעֲנִיֶּיהָ. תַּתָּה לְזִכָּרוֹן:
רָצָה אַחֲרֶיךָ. בְּגֵיא צִיָּה וְצַלְמָוֶת. אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלוֹתֶיהָ. תַּעַשׂ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ
הָלֹךְ וְקָרָאתָ בְאָזְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַֽ͏ִם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ זָכַרְתִּי לָךְ חֶסֶד נְעוּרַיִךְ אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָיִךְ לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה:
שִׁחֲתוּ עַם זוּ. שְׂאֵת שִׁמְצָה בְּקָמֵיהֶם. שֵׂם פֶּסֶל וְלֹא אֵל. שָׁתוּ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
שֶׁכָּלוּ כִּמְעַט רֶגַע. לוּלֵי קָם בַּפֶּרֶץ. מְעוֹרֵר שְׁבוּעָה. וּבְרִית לְזִכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ

זְכֹר לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵל עֲבָדֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לָהֶם בָּךְ וַתְּדַבֵּר אֲלֵהֶם אַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעֲכֶם כְּכֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְכָל הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתִּי אֶתֵּן לְזַרְעֲכֶם וְנָחֲלוּ לְעֹלָם:
תִּעַבְתָּ מֵאָז. עֲדַת כָּל לְאֻמִּים. חֲשַׁקְתָּנוּ מֵהֶם.
עֵדוּת לְזִכָּרוֹן:
תְּמוּר כֶּסֶף נִמְאָס. דּוֹר נִשְׁכַּח קַחְתָּ. קְנֵנוּ שֵׁנִית. כִּי שֻׁכַּחְנוּ מִזִּכָּרוֹן:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּדִבְרֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ
זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ:
תָּר אִישׁ תָּם בְּמִי זַרְעוֹ יְכֻנֶּה. שִׂכֵּל יָדָיו. לְאוֹת וְזִכָּרוֹן:
תְּרַפֵּק מְשׁוּל אֶפְרַיִם. בְּשַׁעֲשׁוּעַ יֶלֶד וּבֵן יַקִּיר. הֲלֹא בְּכוֹרִי הוּא. חַקְתָּ לְזִכָּרוֹן:
I am anxious because of my deeds, I worry constantly, I fear on the day of judgment, when I come for remembrance.
I seek out the Merciful, I entreat the Compassionate, I implore Him who has appointed this day for me for remembrance.
When I come in judgment, on whom shall I rely, who will find righteousness for me as a remembrance?
Upon the fathers I put my trust, I derive benefit from their work, they have from of old served as my remembrance.
My arm was strong when Moses pleaded to be wiped out, so that my name should not be wiped out nor should my remembrance.
Should a man stand before the Lord, can he then help me, when merit is required from me for remembrance.
I rejoiced with him (Aaron) who wore the Ephod and the Breast-plate of Judgment on which my name was engraved for remembrance.
He hastened with his censor until the plague had abated, when a stranger (Korah) approached to act as priest, the flames devoured him as a remembrance.
Behold, O God, when I stand before Thee, there is no man in my midst whom I could designate for remembrance.
Can anyone pray and turn
back anger (like Pinhas),then let his name be inscribed for future generations as a remembrance.
Who is it that hates gain that he might say: “Testify against me”, and the Lord Himself replied as a witness for remembrance.
With a sucking lamb he (Samuel) atoned for us and, equal to the noble pair of brothers (Moses and Aaron), he rises for remembrance.
When he saw the wrath of the Lord, he (David) said: “Let Thy hand turn against me”, that he conformed to the will of his God is his remembrance.
He cried out and caused the angel’s sword to return to its sheath, therefore was his throne established as firmly as the sun for remembrance.
At the time of drought I wait for Him who releases and brings rain (Elijah), who restored breath to the child already lost to remembrance.
He lives on as a witness at circumcisions because he spoke of his zeal when the people had abandoned both covenant and remembrance.
Formerly I had one who could atone before the Lord, when he brought the meal-offering as a bribe for remembrance.
Gifts of nard and spices perfumed His chambers, blood and fat as a delight and the show-bread for remembrance.
I was placed like an empty vessel upon the coals, that Israel may not be widowed, I plead
for remembrance.
O Lord, in Thee do I trust and not in princes, for they are in the grave and Thy Name is for ever for remembrance.
All these supported me but I seek Thy compassion, without it I should have perished and not survived for remembrance.
For in spite of their strength, they could not plead for me before Thee, those in whose mouths is Thy greatness have placed it there for remembrance.
For this day has been stored the sum of assessments, it is the beginning of days and the first for remembrance.
On it there is read out what was engraved with a diamond quill, what was revealed and explained and known in remembrance.
Death and life, peace and war, dearth and abundance, appear for remembrance.
The acts of man, the number of his steps, though forgotten by men, they are to God for remembrance.
“My way is hidden” — who could say that? In vain was a sin inscribed for me for remembrance.
In front of man his deeds give evidence, his falsehood bears witness against him for remembrance.
Proclaim the plans of the Lord, all men together, pass under the staff like a flock for remembrance.
The Lord closes the door on behalf of the flawless during
the storm until their destiny arrives and they go forth for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.
Perform wonders for the living lest they become like the dead; is then Thy truth in the grave for remembrance?
Once Thou didst pity because of noble deeds; pity us now even though we are without deeds; wilt Thou not make for Thy wonders a remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’.
And it was said:
‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.
Turn, O God, to those who sit in the gardens (houses of study), listen how they speak of Thy law for remembrance.
Let their work appear before Thee; though they eat the bread of anguish, their reward is with Thee in the book of remembrance.
As it is written through Thy prophet:
‘Then those who fear God speak one to the other and God listens and hears, and it is inscribed in the book of remembrance before Him on behalf of those who fear the Lord and respect His Name’.
The foxes (Egyptians), the destroyers of vineyards, planned to cut off from the vine its root and remembrance.
They oppressed them (Israel) with hardship, they cried out to Thee and were saved because of the piety of the forefathers who had been inscribed for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.
In days of old Thou didst see generations in whom there was no delight. Thou hast let them vanish and perish without a remembrance.
One generation hast Thou chosen from among a thousand and allotted them Thy words; for their sake in every generation hast Thou engraved them for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy words:
‘He remembers for ever His covenant, the word He commanded for a thousand generations’.
The Exalted One took great delight in the youthful bride (Israel); her slain and her afflicted hast Thou set for remembrance.
She ran behind Thee in the dry and dark valley, the love of her betrothal wilt Thou make for a remembrance.
As it was written through Thy prophet:

‘Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem saying: ‘Thus says the Lord: I remember unto you the grace of your youth, the love of your betrothal, when you followed Me in the wilderness, in land unsown!’.
This people became corrupt and bore the insults of its enemies, a powerless idol did they set up as a remembrance.
They were almost annihilated had not Moses stood in the breach, recalling the oath and the covenant for remembrance.
As it is written in Thy Torah:

‘Remember Abraham, Isaac and Israel, Thy servants to whom Thou didst swear by Thyself and to whom Thou didst speak: I will multiply Thy seed like the stars of the heavens, and all this land of which I have spoken, I will give to your seed that they may inherit it for ever’.
Thou hast from of old rejected the assembly of peoples, in us hast Thou found delight as testimony for
remembrance.

Instead of the despised silver (of Israel in the time of Jeremiah) Thou didst choose the forgotten generation (of Israel in Babylon); acquire us once again for we have been forgotten from remembrance.
As it is written in Thy holy writings:
‘Remember Thy cogregation whom Thou didst acquire in days of old, the tribe whom Thou didst redeem as Thy inheritance, this Mount of Zion upon which Thou didst dwell’.
He examined the flawless (Jacob), after whom his seed was to be called, he intertwined his hands as a sign and remembrance.
Be tender with Ephraim who was likened to a delightful child and a dear son; is he not my firstborn whom Thou hast inscribed for remembrance.

As it was written through Thy prophet:
כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ
וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נֹחַ וְאֵת כָּל־הַחַיָּה וְאֶת־כָּל־הַבְּהֵמָה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בַּתֵּבָה וַיַּעֲבֵר אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ עַל־הָאָרֶץ וַיָּשֹׁכּוּ הַמָּיִם:
וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיִּשְׁמַע אֱלֹהִים אֶת־נַאֲקָתָם וַיִּזְכֹּר אֱלֹהִים אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ אֶת־
אַבְרָהָם אֶת־יִצְחָק וְאֶת־יַעֲקֹב:
וְנֶאֱמַר
וְזָכַרְתִּי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יַעֲקוֹב וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי יִצְחָק וְאַף אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אַבְרָהָם אֶזְכֹּר וְהָאָרֶץ אֶזְכֹּר:
וּבְדִבְרֵי קָדְשְׁךָ כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ:
וְנֶאֱמַר
טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכּוֹר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:
וְנֶאֱמַר
וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חֲסָדָיו:
וְעַל־יְדֵי עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים כָּתוּב לֵאמֹר
הָלֹךְ וְקָרָאתָ בְאָזְנֵי יְרוּשָׁלַֽ͏ִם לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ זָכַרְתִּי לָךְ חֶסֶד נְעוּרַיִךְ אַהֲבַת כְּלוּלֹתָיִךְ לֶכְתֵּךְ אַחֲרַי בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא זְרוּעָה:
וְנֶאֱמַר
וְזָכַרְתִּי אֲנִי אֶת־בְּרִיתִי אוֹתָךְ בִּימֵי נְעוּרָיִךְ וַהֲקִימוֹתִי לָךְ בְּרִית עוֹלָם:
וְנֶאֱמַר
as it is written in Thy Torah:
‘God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the cattle that were with him in the ark, and God caused a wind to pass over the earth and the waters subsided’.
And it was said:
‘God heard their cry, then God remembered His covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob’.
And it was said:
‘I will remember my covenant with Jacob as well as my covenant
with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham will I also remember, and the land will I remember.’
And in Thy holy words it is written:
‘A memorial has He made for His wonders, gracious and compassionate is the Lord’.
And it was said:
‘He gave food to those that fear Him, He will remember His covenant for ever’.
And it was said:
‘He remembered unto them His covenant and He reversed the decree according to the abundance of His kindness’.
And through Thy servants the prophets it is written saying:
‘Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: I remember unto you the grace of your youth, the love of your betrothal, when you followed me in the wilderness in land unsown’.
And it was said:
‘I will remember My covenant with you in the days of your youth and establish with you an everlasting covenant’.

fragments.text: הֲבֵן יַקִּיר לִי אֶפְרַיִם אִם יֶלֶד שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים כִּי־מִדֵּי דַבְּרִי בּוֹ זָכֹר אֶזְכְּרֶנּוּ עוֹד עַל־כֵּן הָמוּ מֵעַי לוֹ רַחֵם אֲרַחֲמֶנּוּ נְאֻם־יְיָ:
‘Is Ephraim a dear son to me, or a delightful child that whenever I speak of him, I still remember him? Accordingly, my love for him is aroused, I shall surely have compassion on him, says the Lord’.
זְכֹר בְּרִית אַבְרָהָם וַעֲקֵדַת יִצְחָק וְהָשֵׁב שְׁבוּת אָהֳלֵי יַעֲקֹב וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:
Remember the covenant of Abraham and the binding of Isaac and return the captivity of the tents of Jacob and save us for the sake of Thy Name.
